#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Source Analysis">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />

<img src="data:image/bmp;base64," class="Icon" /> Source Analysis</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Source Analysis">

Displays information for source analysis samples, including composition, C6+ information, and C7+ information.  Each sample will be printed individually. Sample selection is based on the effective dates.

If the source analysis being reported has full analysis enabled, this report will include an additional section to display the TP-17 information associated with the sample. (See: [Full Analysis - Gas](../../Source%20Analysis/Gas%20Quality%20Source%20Editor/Source%20Analysis%20Tab.md#SourceAnalysis-Gas) and [Full Analysis - Liquid](../../Source%20Analysis/Liquid%20Quality%20Source%20Editor/Source%20Analysis%20Tab.md#FullAnalysis-Liquid))

This report can also be run by clicking the **Print** button in the GQ or LQ Source Analysis Editor Detail screen.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="Icon" style="width: 15;height: 15;" /> Schedule Editor Group Name: Source Analysis



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="Icon" style="width: 15;height: 15;" /> View Sample Reports:

- <a href="../../../Resources/PDFs/Report%20Examples/Source%20Analysis%20-%20Gas.pdf" target="_blank">Source Analysis - Gas</a>
- <a href="../../../Resources/PDFs/Report%20Examples/Source%20Analysis%20-%20Liquid.pdf" target="_blank">Source Analysis - Liquid</a>
- <a href="../../../Resources/PDFs/Report%20Examples/Source%20Analysis%20-%20Full.pdf" target="_blank">Source Analysis (Full Analysis)</a>

</div>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Source Exception Detail">

Displays details of source analysis exceptions, including the exception name, when it was generated, the field value, and the alarm limit. Users can specify a specific exception code to look for, or, if one is not specified, all exceptions that meet the remaining criteria will be displayed. Standalone sample exceptions cannot be seen in the listing.
